jobs.title: GTM Partnerships Lead
jobs.description:
Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.


We’re looking for a GTM Partnerships Lead to help us build and scale a thriving ecosystem of partners across multiple channels, including System Integrators (SIs), affiliates and resellers. This is a high-impact role with both strategic and operational responsibility. You’ll help build the foundation for several of our partner programs, own key relationships, and work cross-functionally to ensure customers and partners both succeed.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Help scale Attio's Expert Program, growing a thriving ecosystem of consultants, agencies, and independent operators who help customers successfully adopt Attio.

 - Recruit, onboard, and enable new partners, creating playbooks, training, and resources that help them become successful quickly.

 - Build lasting relationships with top partners, helping them grow their businesses while making Attio their CRM of choice.

 - Design programs that incentivize partner engagement, referrals, implementations, and long-term customer success.

 - Work closely with Sales to identify partnership opportunities that accelerate customer acquisition and expansion.

 - Partner with Marketing to create co-marketing campaigns, customer stories, webinars, events, and educational content.

 - Collaborate with Product to ensure partners have early access, clear documentation, and a feedback loop into the product roadmap.

 - Identify and launch new partnership motions — including channel partnerships, referral programs, etc.

 - Define the systems, metrics, and operating cadence that allow partnerships to scale as Attio grows.

 - Measure the impact of partnerships across pipeline, customer acquisition, implementation quality, product adoption, and expansion.


ABOUT YOU:

 - You have 5+ years of experience in partnerships, channel, success, solutions, or similar roles — ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.

 - You’ve built or contributed to SI, channel, expert or service partner programs from the ground up or helped scale one at a high-growth company.

 - You’re equal parts strategic thinker and scrappy operator — comfortable with ambiguity and excited to build.

 - You think commercially. You understand what motivates partners and know how to create programs that align incentives for everyone involved.

 - You’re a strong communicator and relationship builder, able to manage multiple external partners while aligning internal stakeholders.

 - You’re process-oriented but not rigid — you know how to design systems that evolve with the business.

 - You’re energized by helping others succeed — both customers and partners.

 - Most importantly, you're excited about helping build the ecosystem around one of the fastest-growing CRM companies in the world.


BONUS POINTS IF:

 - You’ve worked on CRM, RevOps, or implementation services in the past.

 - You have experience working with international or vertical-specific partners.

 - You’ve helped launch partner portals, certifications, or marketplaces.


WHAT DOES THE HIRING PROCESS LOOK LIKE?

We respond to candidates within 48 hours of each interview.

Applicants can expect the following:

 1. Introductory phone call - 30 minutes

 2. Hiring manager call - 30 minutes

 3. Live Exercise - 45 minutes

 4. Interview panel - 3 x 30 minutes

 5. Final call - 30 minutes

 6. Offer call

A lot of our interviews are enabled through self-scheduling but we are always on hand to speak to you or answer questions throughout the process. At the offer stage, you may want to speak to more of the team, see a demo, or have other suggestions for us.




WHAT WILL AN OFFER CONSIST OF?

 - A competitive salary of between $160,000 to $220,000

 - Equity in an early-stage tech company on an incredible trajectory

 - 25 days plus local holidays

 - 401K

 - Apple laptop and accessories

 - Private medical insurance through Cigna or Kaiser where available

 - Private dental and vision

 - Enhanced parental leave

 - Team off-site in fun places!

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Customer Success is central to how we build, grow, and deliver value at Attio.

As a Customer Success Manager, you'll own a portfolio of our highest-potential customers, building deep relationships and helping them get meaningful value from Attio as their businesses grow.

Attio has a highly product-led customer base, and many of our most promising customers start as small, fast-growing teams. Success in this role isn't defined by customer size or current spend alone. You'll need to recognize potential early, understand where a customer's business is headed, and help them build the right foundations to scale with Attio.

This is a highly consultative and hands-on role. You'll understand each customer's GTM motion, uncover what they're trying to achieve, and translate their business needs into thoughtful recommendations across their workflows, data, and use of Attio. You'll work with fast-moving customers who expect you to bring both strategic thinking and strong product expertise.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own and develop relationships across a portfolio of high-potential customers.

 - Lead customers through onboarding, adoption, ongoing value realization, renewals, and expansion.

 - Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business, GTM motion, goals, and challenges.

 - Identify potential early within a product-led customer base and help customers deepen their adoption as they grow.

 - Advise customers on how to structure their workflows, processes, and use of Attio to support their business.

 - Balance strategic relationship management with hands-on solutioning, moving comfortably between business goals and product configuration.

 - Build relationships with stakeholders across customer organizations and become a trusted partner as their businesses evolve.

 - Use customer data, product insights, and business context to identify risks and opportunities across your portfolio.

 - Identify opportunities for deeper adoption and expansion based on customer needs and growth.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, RevOps, Solutions Engineering, Support, and Sales to solve customer problems and continuously improve the customer experience.

 - Bring customer insights back into Attio to help shape our product and Customer Success motion.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of relevant professional experience, including 3+ years in Customer Success or Account Management.

 - Experience owning customer relationships in B2B software, ideally across SMB and mid-market customers in a product-led environment.

 - A consultative approach and ability to understand a customer's business before jumping to a solution.

 - Strong product instincts and a track record of coaching customers on how to get the most out of a complex software product.

 - Comfort working hands-on with customers to solve problems rather than relying heavily on separate technical or implementation teams.

 - Experience owning customer outcomes across adoption, retention, renewals, and expansion.

 - Strong commercial instincts and an ability to recognize customer potential beyond current spend or company size.

 - Comfort working with fast-growing companies and lean teams where priorities and needs can change quickly.

 - A data-driven approach to prioritizing your portfolio, identifying risk, and uncovering opportunities.

 - Experience working at an early- or growth-stage startup.

 - A proactive mindset and comfort operating with autonomy in a fast-moving environment.


WHAT DOES THE HIRING PROCESS LOOK LIKE?

 1. Talent Introduction

 2. Hiring Manager Interview

 3. Solutioning Exercise

 4. Meet the Team: Three focused conversations with key stakeholders

 5. Executive Leadership Conversation

 6. References & Offer
